alignmentRule: Kneecap forward first and the foot follows. Tripod foot (big-toe base, little-toe base, heel). A 10–15° toe-out is normal.

dailyRoutine.name: Short foot
dailyRoutine.cue: Arch up, toes long, big-toe base stays down.

dailyRoutine.name: Big toe press
dailyRoutine.cue: Press the big toe down with the other four toes lifted.

dailyRoutine.name: Wall tibialis raise
dailyRoutine.cue: Both feet. Heels down, kneecaps forward, lift the forefoot.

dailyRoutine.name: Wall calf stretch
dailyRoutine.cue: (a) straight knee for the calf, (b) bent knee for soleus and Achilles.

dailyRoutine.name: Standing outer hip stretch
dailyRoutine.cue: Leg crossed behind, push the hip out, arm over the top.

dailyRoutine.name: Chin tucks
dailyRoutine.cue: Back of the head to the wall, make a double chin, hold 3 s.

dailyRoutine.name: Neck stretch
dailyRoutine.cue: (a) ear to shoulder, (b) nose to armpit. Gentle, no pulling.

dailyRoutine.name: Bed chest stretch
dailyRoutine.cue: Forearm on the bed, elbow at shoulder height, rotate away.

dailyRoutine.name: Kneeling thoracic extension
dailyRoutine.cue: Elbows on the bed edge, hips back, lower back flat. Let the upper back sink.

dailyRoutine.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor
dailyRoutine.cue: Squeeze the glute of the back leg, tuck the pelvis, shift forward a little.

dailyRoutine.name: Thread the needle
dailyRoutine.cue: On all fours, slide one arm under the body, pause, then open up to the ceiling.

dailyRoutine.name: 90/90 switches
dailyRoutine.cue: Lead with the back knee. Knees track, no forcing.

dailyRoutine.name: Side-lying hip internal rotation
dailyRoutine.cue: Knees together, the top foot lifts.

dailyRoutine.name: Knee-to-opposite-shoulder
dailyRoutine.cue: On your back, draw the knee toward the opposite shoulder.

dailyRoutine.name: Hand-assisted hamstring
dailyRoutine.cue: (a) kneecap to ceiling, (b) across the body with hips flat, (c) leg turned in.

morningDrillsNote: Do 1 set of each, building to 3.

selfChecks.name: Shin rotation check
selfChecks.how: Seated on a high chair, compare foot angles.

squat.name: Hip CARs
squat.cue: Biggest slow circle with the knee.
